observations: Photo 0: white Xbox One S console still wrapped in plastic, held by a hand near a window; Xbox logo visible on top panel.
Photo 1: closer angle of the same wrapped console, vent pattern and Xbox logo visible; no ports, no disc slot, no rear visible.
No controller/pad visible in either photo despite the text claim.
No receipt, box, or power-on screen shown in either photo.
Background shows a shop counter with unrelated items (hard drives, phone cases) and a 'BLESSED OBI VENTURES' watermark, consistent with a reseller stall, not a verification of the unit's condition.

claims.evidence: Front/disc-slot area not shown in either photo; cannot confirm absence of disc drive.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No internal or serial/seal photo provided to support this.
No power-on test, no rear port shot, no usage clip provided.
No controller/pad visible in photo 0 or photo 1; only the console itself is shown.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault
risks.proof: Video of console powered on showing Xbox dashboard/home screen
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / worst case functional risk

risks.proof: Photo of console together with the pad(s) claimed

risks.risk: Receipt and provenance unverified, could affect authenticity/import status
risks.proof: Clear photo of the UK receipt with matching serial/date
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified provenance, no premium applied

risks.if_unproven: priced as standard disc edition, no special premium for all-digital

proof_requests: Video of the console powered on, showing the dashboard and confirming no overheating after a few minutes of use
Photo of the console together with the included controller(s)
Clear photo of the UK receipt with legible date and serial match
Front-facing photo showing presence or absence of a disc slot to confirm All-Digital Edition
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an Xbox One S console from the visible logo and shape, but every seller claim (working ports, no overheating, included pads, receipt, all-digital variant) is unverifiable from the photos alone, so it must be priced at worst case as a bare, unverified-working console with no accessories.
